address: 64 Soi Nonnivet 1, Udon Dussadi Road, Mak Khaeng, Mueang Udon Thani, Udon Thani, 41000, Thailand
bio: For over four decades this restaurant has been a mainstay for locals. Focusing on freshwater fish and meat, it serves large sharing portions. Seasonal options and occasional fish specials accompany enduring classics, such as the flavourful deep-fried Pla Som, or snakehead fish in flavoursome tom yum soup. The friendly staff are happy to share their recommendations....
